title: CKPC Properties Track Record | 8M Sq Ft, Fortune 100 Clients & Heart of Harmony, Bengaluru
metaDescription: CKPC Properties has delivered 8 million sq ft of Grade A+ commercial spaces in Bengaluru, trusted by Fortune 100 companies including TCS, Siemens, Bosch and Merck. Now building Heart of Harmony — luxury residential at Kudlu Gate.
h1: CKPC Properties Track Record — 8 Million Sq Ft, Fortune 100 Clients, Now Building Heart of Harmony

blocks.text: CKPC Properties Pvt. Ltd. is a Bengaluru-based real estate developer with over 8 million sq ft of Grade A+ commercial and residential spaces delivered. The company’s commercial tenant roster includes Fortune 100 organisations — Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Siemens, Bosch, Merck, Continental, Rockwell Automation, Syngene, and Manipal Hospitals. With 5 million sq ft of new development under way, CKPC Properties’ flagship residential new launch is CKPC Heart of Harmony — a premium 24-storey high-rise at Kudlu Gate, Hosur Road, Bengaluru.

CKPC Properties has built its portfolio with a clear emphasis on longevity, performance, and consistency across asset classes. The company’s trajectory reflects a disciplined, long-term approach to real estate development — the same approach now applied to Heart of Harmony.
Commercial Portfolio: Built for Scale, Designed for Performance

CKPC’s commercial developments form the backbone of its track record, with 360° Business Park in Electronic City standing out as a defining project. It has been planned as an integrated business environment, rather than a collection of standalone office buildings. The project incorporates large floor plates, advanced building systems, and sustainability-focused design, aligning with the expectations of global occupiers. Its ability to attract long-term tenants, including large-format leases, reflects both the quality of the asset and the reliability of its execution. Across its commercial portfolio, CKPC’s approach remains consistent — it emphasises operational efficiency and the creation of work environments that support evolving workplace needs.

CKPC’s expansion into residential real estate carries forward the same principles seen in its commercial projects: planning-led development, spatial efficiency, and long-term livability. Projects such as Winds of Change in Yelahanka reflect this approach. Spread across 7.5 acres, the development prioritises community planning, landscape integration, and everyday usability. Shared amenities, including a 33,000 sq ft clubhouse, are integrated as part of a broader living ecosystem rather than as standalone features.

Heart of Harmony at Kudlu Gate represents the most ambitious application of these residential principles — a 24-floor, 137-home luxury high-rise with only 6 homes per floor, a vehicle-free podium, 40+ amenities across two levels, and RERA-committed possession in March 2030. RERA: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 .

A key thread connecting CKPC’s commercial and residential developments is its People Experience (PX) philosophy. Rather than treating buildings as static assets, PX focuses on how spaces are used, experienced, and sustained over time. In commercial environments, this translates into efficient layouts, better air quality, and support for employees’ well-being. In residential communities, the focus remains on open spaces, walkability, safety, and shared infrastructure. This philosophy across projects ensures that people experience is not compromised. The underlying objective remains the same in the workplace or at home: to create environments that are intuitive, functional, and adaptable to changing needs.
To understand how the PX philosophy is applied specifically to Heart of Harmony’s design, read The Thinking Behind PX: Designing Spaces Around People Experience .

Global organisations such as Siemens, Merck, Bosch, Continental, and Tata Consultancy trust CKPC with their office spaces. CKPC’s ability to deliver built-to-suit campuses, large-format office environments, and performance-driven workplaces has enabled it to work with companies across sectors. Projects such as The Origin (housing Bosch, Merck, and Rockwell Automation) and Zenith (leased to TCS) demonstrate how CKPC’s developments are built to global standards.
Conclusion: A Track Record That Reflects Enduring Value

CKPC’s journey across commercial and residential real estate — from large-scale office campuses to thoughtfully planned residential communities — demonstrates a consistent commitment to quality, usability, and long-term relevance. As the company continues to expand its footprint, this ability to apply a unified, people-centric approach across different projects is what defines CKPC’s enduring value as a developer.
What Does This Track Record Mean for Heart of Harmony Buyers?

For buyers evaluating Heart of Harmony, CKPC’s commercial track record provides direct context for understanding the developer’s commitment to quality, timelines, and delivery discipline. The execution standards that earned Fortune 100 trust — structural design rigour, regulatory compliance, infrastructure quality, and long-term asset performance — are the same standards being applied to Heart of Harmony.

For an independent buyer-focused analysis of how this track record translates into the Heart of Harmony project — including master plan, specifications, amenities, and the honest pros and cons — read our CKPC Heart of Harmony review .

items.q: What is CKPC Properties' track record?
items.a: CKPC Properties has delivered over 8 million sq ft of Grade A+ commercial spaces in Bengaluru, trusted by Fortune 100 companies including TCS, Siemens, Bosch, Merck, Continental, Rockwell Automation, Syngene and Manipal Hospitals. The company is led by Chirag Purushotam (MD & CEO) and is currently building Heart of Harmony — a luxury residential project at Kudlu Gate, Hosur Road, Bengaluru.

items.q: How much commercial space has CKPC Properties delivered?
items.a: Over 8 million sq ft of Grade A+ commercial spaces delivered in Bengaluru, with an additional 5 million sq ft under development. Key commercial projects include 360° Business Park in Electronic City, The Origin, and Zenith.

items.q: Which Fortune 100 companies are tenants of CKPC Properties?
items.a: CKPC Properties’ Fortune 100 tenant roster includes Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Siemens, Bosch, Merck, Continental, Rockwell Automation, Syngene, and Manipal Hospitals. These organisations trust CKPC for long-term, large-scale commercial workspace solutions in Bengaluru.

items.q: What is 360° Business Park by CKPC?
items.a: 360° Business Park is a Grade A+ commercial campus in Electronic City, Bengaluru, developed by CKPC Properties. It incorporates large, efficient floor plates, advanced building systems, and sustainability certifications. It is the location of CKPC’s landmark 1.4 million sq ft, 15-year lease with TCS.

items.q: What is Reckitt Tower by CKPC Properties?
items.a: Reckitt Tower is a commercial development by CKPC Properties in Bengaluru, developed in partnership with a major global consumer goods company. It is one of several built-to-suit commercial campuses in CKPC’s portfolio demonstrating the company’s ability to deliver bespoke large-format workplaces.

items.q: Is CKPC Properties a reliable builder for residential apartments?
items.a: Yes. CKPC Properties brings 8 million sq ft of Grade A+ delivery experience to Heart of Harmony. The project is fully RERA registered — RERA: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 — with all floor plans, possession timelines, and financial disclosures legally mandated and verifiable. Possession date: March 2030.

items.q: Who is the CEO of CKPC Properties?
items.a: Chirag Purushotam is the Managing Director and CEO of CKPC Properties Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru. Under his leadership, CKPC has delivered 8 million sq ft of Grade A+ commercial spaces and launched Heart of Harmony — a luxury residential project at Kudlu Gate, Hosur Main Road, Bengaluru 560068.

items.q: Where are CKPC Properties projects located?
items.a: CKPC Properties’ commercial projects are concentrated in Bengaluru, with major developments in Electronic City (360° Business Park) and across South and Central Bengaluru. Heart of Harmony, their flagship residential project, is at Kudlu Gate, Hosur Main Road, Bengaluru 560068 — 400 metres from Kudlu Gate Metro Station (Yellow Line).

items.q: What is CKPC's People Experience (PX) approach?
items.a: People Experience (PX) is CKPC Properties’ design philosophy — placing everyday usability, movement, wellness, and social interaction at the centre of every design decision. In commercial projects, PX translates into efficient layouts, employee-focused amenities, and open, adaptable workspaces. In Heart of Harmony, PX is applied through the vehicle-free podium, private sky garden terraces on every third floor, 6 homes per floor for privacy, and two-level amenity distribution across podium and rooftop clubhouse. Read more: The Thinking Behind PX .
